source.title: A ‘set’ of ancient bronze bells excavated in Changsha, Hunan Province, China
source.scope: Ten bells found together at Shiguzhai in June 1993; the paper dates their manufacture to the twelfth century BCE.

limits: Reference sounds are synthesized sine tones, not recordings.
Source lists omit repeated frequencies and contain no frequency occurrence counts or strike chronology.
Modern note names use twelve-tone equal temperament with A4 = 439.524 Hz.
Nearest-key coverage does not establish an ancient tuning system.
